title: Rigidity of bounded $Γ$-equivariant holomorphic maps for $π_1$ of irreducible Shimura varieties of rank $\ge 2$ via Kähler geometry, harmonic analysis and ergodic theory
summary: In a recent article of the authors, we proved a result called the Isomorphism Theorem for holomorphic maps from an irreducible Shimura varieties of rank $\ge 2$. The proof of the Isomorphism Theorem uses in essential ways Kähler geometry, function theory of several complex variables, harmonic analysis and ergodic theory.
